snippet.title: Golf at the speed of pinball? Ballgame demo is LIVE on STEAM!
snippet.description:
⛳️ Play the Ballgame Demo: https://huco.click/demo

Out today: a hole new Ballgame Demo. Available now on Steam for PC & Mac, the demo includes a golf-meets-pinball tournament, a heist-inspired race against the clock, and an intro to the mysterious hotel for lost balls. Can you make it under par? Can you find the cosmic path and make it in zero?

Try, die, and try again in a frenetic physics playground full of hazards and delights! Discover dozens and dozens of devious holes while you leap in bullet-time, float in bubbles, grind on rails, and die on spikes. Cause mayhem … or just play freaking golf!
